name: Tiling
description: Partition loop nests into smaller rectangular blocks to fit intermediate results in L1/L2 cache, enabling cache-efficient computation of matmul, convolution, and other structured loop nests.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: A list of positive integers or zeros representing the tile size for each loop dimension. Zero means no tiling for that dimension. Example: [8, 16, 4] tiles the first three loops with sizes 8, 16, and 4 respectively.
